decide.ruby: p ThinkThen.decide("Is this a complaint?", "I demand a refund today")

choose.ruby: p ThinkThen.choose("Which team owns this?", "please route this ticket", options: ["the refund desk", "the maybe desk", "anywhere else"])

tag.ruby: p ThinkThen.tag("Which words appear?", "the refund and the shipping", labels: ["refund", "shipping"])

score.ruby: p ThinkThen.score("How urgent is this?", "maybe later", levels: ["Routine.", "Soon.", "Immediate."])

filter.ruby: p ThinkThen.filter("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"])

rank.ruby: p ThinkThen.rank("Is this a complaint?", ["good morning", "I demand a refund today"]).map { |one| [one.record, one.probability] }

find.ruby: p ThinkThen.find("Which line asks for money back?", ["good morning", "I want a refund"]).then { |one| [one.unit, one.probability] }

files.form.json: {"version":1,"questions":{"refund":{"decide":"Does the customer ask for a refund?"},"complaint":{"decide":"Is this a complaint?","threshold":0.5}}}

recognize.ruby: p ThinkThen.recognize("Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight in Chicago last spring.", kinds: %w[person organization place]).entities.map { |one| [one.text, one.kind] }

relate.ruby: p ThinkThen.relate([["Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.", "alert"], ["The payments database ran out of disk space.", "alert"]], relations: %w[caused_by]).map { |one| [one.relation, one.source.name, one.target.name, one.probability] }
relate.expected: [["caused_by", "Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.", "The payments database ran out of disk space.", 0.9], ["caused_by", "The payments database ran out of disk space.", "Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.", 0.9]]
